description: This file contains detailed documentation for the Composite Input HAL interface, describing its overview, functional requirements, class and method definitions, system context, resource management, operation flows, state machine, capabilities, and implementation considerations. It is not a traditional executable source code file but a structured design/specification document to guide development and integration.

classes.name: ICompositeInputManager
classes.description: Manager interface for discovering and accessing composite input ports.

classes.name: ICompositeInputPort
classes.description: Per-port control interface for configuration, status, and capabilities.

classes.name: IPortEventListener
classes.description: Callback interface for port events such as connection and signal status changes.

classes.name: IPortTelemetryListener
classes.description: Callback interface for telemetry data updates.

classes.name: PlatformCapabilities
classes.description: Interface describing platform-wide features and support flags.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Port-specific capabilities, including supported properties and metrics support.

classes.name: PortStatus
classes.description: Struct representing current status including connection, signal, and video mode.

classes.name: Port
classes.description: Port metadata such as name and description.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enum representing signal states: NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, NOT_SUPPORTED.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Parcelable representing video resolution and format details.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry metrics for signal lock time, drops, uptime, etc.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair structure for batch property queries.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Metadata describing property types and attributes.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Returns list of available composite input port IDs.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns capabilities of the port, including supported properties and metrics support.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Returns platform capabilities and supported features.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns a port interface for a specific port ID.

methods.name: getPortInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about a port, such as name and description.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Queries the current value of a property by key.

methods.name: getPropertyMulti
methods.description: Retrieves multiple properties in a batch query.
